brief: Holds the limits of a whole number the way C# int.MinValue and int.MaxValue name them, for porting C# code to Ring.
detail: The global int is one of these. The limits are the library's calculable-integer limits, 15 nines, and they come back as text with underscores, so they print well and do not compare. Build one without parentheses: new IntObject() raises R3.
